title: Unveiling the Dual Mechanisms of Solanum nigrum L. Fractions Against Ovarian Cancer via AKT/NF-kappaB and Tumor Microenvironment Modulation: An In Silico and In Vitro Study.
authors: Kang, Eun-Ji; Kim, Eun-Hye; Lee, Hwi-Ho; Jeon, Yong-Deok; Choi, Jung-Hye; Ahn, Ji-Hye
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过网络药理学和分子对接探讨龙葵组分对卵巢癌的AKT/NF-kB通路及肿瘤微环境调控，虽含分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ovarian cancer treatment remains challenging due to aggressive metastasis and the complex tumor microenvironment (TME). Solanum nigrum L. (SN), a berry-bearing plant rich in bioactive phytochemicals, offers promising multi-target anticancer potential. This study elucidated the systemic molecular mechanisms of SN fractions against ovarian cancer by integrating network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vitro models. In silico analyses and molecular docking identified apoptosis, metastasis-related pathways, and NF-kappaB (RELA) as core targets. For in vitro validation, butanol (SNBT) and methylene chloride (SNMC) fractions of SN were evaluated in SKOV3 cells. SNBT significantly induced caspase-3-dependent apoptosis, while SNMC effectively suppressed cancer cell migration and invasion without cytotoxicity. Furthermore, both fractions markedly downregulated phosphorylated AKT and NF-kappaB, experimentally confirming the suppression of the AKT/NF-kappaB signaling axis. Crucially, in a tumor-associated macrophage co-culture model, SNMC attenuated the pro-metastatic TME by reducing MMP2, MMP9, and VEGF secretion. Conclusively, SN exerts potent anticancer effects through distinct fractional activities, such as driving apoptosis and blocking metastasis, mediated via AKT/NF-kappaB inhibition and TME remodeling. These findings highlight SN-derived fractions as promising multi-target therapeutic candidates against ovarian cancer.
abstract_zh: 卵巢癌的治疗因侵袭性转移和复杂的肿瘤微环境（TME）而仍具挑战性。龙葵（Solanum nigrum L.，SN）是一种富含生物活性植物化学物质的浆果植物，具有多靶点抗癌潜力。本研究通过整合网络药理学、分子对接和体外模型，阐明了SN组分对抗卵巢癌的系统性分子机制。计算机分析和分子对接确定凋亡、转移相关通路及NF-kappaB（RELA）为核心靶点。在体外验证中，评估了SN的丁醇（SNBT）和二氯甲烷（SNMC）组分在SKOV3细胞中的作用。SNBT显著诱导caspase-3依赖性凋亡，而SNMC在无细胞毒性情况下有效抑制癌细胞迁移和侵袭。此外，两种组分均显著下调磷酸化AKT和NF-kappaB，实验证实了AKT/NF-kappaB信号轴的抑制。关键的是，在肿瘤相关巨噬细胞共培养模型中，SNMC通过减少MMP2、MMP9和VEGF分泌，减弱了促转移的TME。总之，SN通过不同组分活性发挥强效抗癌作用，如驱动凋亡和阻断转移，这些作用由AKT/NF-kappaB抑制和TME重塑介导。这些发现凸显了SN衍生组分作为对抗卵巢癌的有前景的多靶点治疗候选物。
